lines.text: The LORD gives Jeremiah a word about the Philistines before Pharaoh strikes down Gaza.
Waters from the north become an overflowing torrent, and the people wail at galloping stallions and rumbling chariots.
The LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Tarshish.
The people of Gaza will shave their heads in mourning, and Ashkelon will be silenced.
The sword cannot rest, because the king of Babylon has commanded it against the shore of its coastland.
